interpretation: The correct finite-sample object is a plug-in/sample-analogue estimator of the population identified set, not a confidence set forced to contain the realized hidden labels. The minimum-relaxation repair only restores feasibility when needed and vanishes with n. Confidence-region construction for the population identified set is a separate inferential layer.
next_step: Run a real iNaturalist trajectory pilot using the plug-in estimator, report the required eta_hat by node/horizon, and verify that real-data sample sizes are large enough for the empirical sensitivity polytope to be informative before training image models.
